status: WORKING NON-CANON; representation verification, not geological acceptance
scope: W01 stage 3: shared static polygon boundaries, oriented sides, regional adjacency, point contacts and cyclic junction sectors in a plane or one declared conditioned spherical domain chart
invariants: Exactly one stored directed atomic segment per geometric boundary; no separately guessed neighbour traces.
Areal coverage is complete and nonoverlapping, with no clipping, snapping, tolerance-based repair or deleted slivers.
Occupied material is left of a normalised CCW shell or CW hole. Direction reversal swaps owners and signs.
Region identity differs from plate identity; same-plate patch joins are explicitly seams, not tectonic boundaries.
Point contact is not positive-length adjacency, and ordinary corners are not claimed tectonic junctions.
Cyclic junction sectors agree between outgoing half-edges; no averaged tangent at a junction.
Spherical topology uses one declared valid chart; metric tangent/normal/distance uses the sphere, not chart metres.
Numerical reprojection gaps are refused; arbitrary whole-sphere atlas stitching remains unsupported.
Velocity diagnostics consume supplied motion; they do not predict forces, slab polarity or stage-6 forcing.
No field transport, material-event, numerical tolerance, or W03 code is modified.
